title: Xometry Deepens AI-Native Marketplace Advantage with New Enterprise Lead Time Intelligence and Personalized Pricing Models
excerpt: Xometry says its models use geometry, quote configurations, customer history, supplier performance and delivery outcomes to predict lead times and personalize pricing.
summary: The issuer describes a closed-loop data architecture spanning CAD geometry, quoting, supplier selection, production performance and delivery outcomes. It supports the proposed automated design-to-fulfillment mechanism, but discloses neither model accuracy levels nor AI-originated demand conversion or incremental unit economics.
